sources.excerpt: Vemuram Galea | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Vemuram Galea Galea The Vemuram Galea is a medium-gain overdrive pedal designed to emulate the classic tones of the late 50's Fender Tweed Deluxe (5E3 Circuit) and the Fender Tone-Master. This pedal features controls for Level, Gain, Bass, Mid, and Treble, alongside SAT and DRV trimmers for fine-tuning your sound. Achieve a tube-like tone and shape your sound with this versatile pedal, inspired by Fender Tweed Deluxe . What Vemuram say about the Galea The Galea was designed to recreate the legendary late 50's Fender Tweed Deluxe(5E3 Circuit) and the Tone-Master from the 90's built by Fender Custom Shop. Equipped with 2 trimmers SAT(Saturation) and DRV(Drive). The SAT trimmer allows you to achieve the tube like tone. The DRV trimmer lets you control the gain of the tone. The 3 EQ controls allows you to achieve many variations and controls your tone for your specific needs. www.vemuram.com Galea compared to ... sources.excerpt: Vemuram Galea | Distortion 0 YOUR CART $ 0.00 Home Bass Guitars Cello Acoustic Guitar Electric Guitars Effects Pedals Home  /  Guitars  /  Effects for Guitars  /  Distortion  / Vemuram Galea Vemuram Galea $70.00 $35.00 In Stock Quantity Add To Cart Share: SKU: GIT0042122-000 Category: Distortion , Effects for Guitars , Guitars Description Medium Gain Overdrive Effect Pedal for Electric Guitar The Vemuram Galea is a medium gain overdrive effect pedal with a rich, rich sound. The complex, hand-wired circuitry, which is tested and carefully tuned during production under real conditions, reacts to the playing style with the lively dynamics of a first-class tube amplifier and thus enables expressive electric guitar playing. To adjust the sound, the pedal, which is housed in a solid brass housing , offers controls for gain and level as well as a 3-band equalizer . At the front there are also two trim potentiometers, which can be used to determine the saturation of the distortion and the general gain intensity. The Vemuram Budi at a glance: Medium Gain Overdrive Effect Pedal for Electric Guitar Handmade in Japan Controls for Level, Gain, Bass, Mid, Treble Trim potentiometer for saturation and drive on the front side Housing made of solid brass Operation with 9V battery or optionally available power supply unit The Vemuram Galea is a medium gain overdrive that sets standards with its first-class sound. The Galea is a Vemuram overdrive voiced after tweed-era amp tones, developed with blues guitarist Josh Smith and built into the brand's machined brass enclosure. It delivers a dynamic, touch-sensitive low-to-medium gain drive with a warm, lightly compressed feel that responds to picking and guitar volume, cleaning up when you back off and pushing into fuller overdrive wide open. It suits blues and roots players wanting an amp-like drive rather than a mid-heavy screamer voice.
